# Recap

> Recap is a Swift package for building markdown-driven "What's New" screens in SwiftUI, with customizable presentation, display-policy logic, and Mac Catalyst support.

Recap is primarily used through `ReleasesParser`, `RecapScreen`, `RecapDisplayPolicy`, and the `View+Recap` modifiers. Agents should prefer these public APIs over custom parsing or custom presentation logic.

## Quick Start

- [README](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/README.md): Main integration guide, customization examples, and installation instructions.

## Release Format

- [Creating Releases](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/README.md#creating-releases): The markdown schema for authoring release history.
- [Demo Releases file](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Demo/Demo/Assets/Releases.md): A complete example of a Recap-compatible releases markdown file.
- [Release model](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/Release.swift): The public `Release` type used after parsing.
- [ReleasesParser](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/ReleasesParser.swift): Public API for turning markdown into releases.

## Display Policy

- [Display Policies](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/README.md#display-policies): How to decide when to present a recap screen.
- [RecapDisplayPolicy](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/RecapDisplayPolicy.swift): Main display-policy API.
- [RecapDisplayPolicy.Trigger](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/RecapDisplayPolicy.Trigger.swift): Trigger configuration for display-policy rules.
- [SemanticVersion](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/SemanticVersion.swift): Semantic version comparison used by display policies.

## Screen Customization

- [Customize Your Release Screen](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/README.md#customize-your-release-screen): Overview of Recap modifiers and styling hooks.
- [RecapScreen](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/RecapScreen.swift): The main SwiftUI screen type and pagination behavior.
- [View+Recap](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/View%2BRecap.swift): Public view modifiers for styling and behavior.
- [RecapScreenPaginationStyle](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/RecapScreenPaginationStyle.swift): Pagination style options including `automatic`, `labeled`, and `compact`.
- [RecapScreenDismissButtonVisibility](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/RecapScreenDismissButtonVisibility.swift): Controls whether the dismiss button is shown.
- [RecapScreenStartIndex](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Sources/Recap/Public/RecapScreenStartIndex.swift): Controls which page is initially selected.

## Demo

- [Demo app](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/tree/main/Demo): Demo project showing Recap in a simple SwiftUI app.
- [DemoRecapScreen](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Demo/Demo/DemoRecapScreen.swift): Example Recap configuration for the demo.
- [App.Demo](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/blob/main/Demo/Demo/App.Demo.swift): Scene setup for iOS and Mac Catalyst presentation.

## API Reference

- [Public API directory](https://github.com/mergesort/Recap/tree/main/Sources/Recap/Public): Source of truth for the public surface area.
